elements.text:
A Magician who only reads is half a Magician. The last tab of the /bPodium/z is where you stop reading and start writing.

  Put a book on the Podium and open that tab. There are three trades in it: stickers, /bInsert/z, and /bWrite/z.

  Each one has to be paid for. The Podium has a single slot, and the buttons stay dark until you put the right thing in it.

  /bInsert/z needs /bPaper/z. With a sheet in the slot you can add three things to the book.

  A /bTable of Contents/z goes to the front, and a book can only have one. A /bChapter/z splits what comes after it from what came before. A /bWritable Page/z is a blank page, and that is the useful one.

  Each is added just after the page you are on, so turn to the right place first.

  A blank page does not stay blank. Look at it and you will see a quill sitting in the middle.
